entities.summary: Hissa Hilal is a Saudi Arabian poet. Previously published under the pseudonym Remia, she gained fame outside the Arab world in 2010 when she recited a poem against fatwas on Million's Poet, an Emirati reality television poetry competition, and became the first woman to reach the program's finals.
